sentences.en: A The story of tea began in ancient China over 5,000 years ago.
sentences.zh: 茶的故事始于五千多年前的古代中国。

sentences.en: According to legend, the Emperor Shen Nung was a skilled ruler, creative scientist and patron of the arts.
sentences.zh: 相传，神农帝是一位治国有方的君主、富有创造力的科学家，也是艺术的赞助者。

sentences.en: His far-sighted edicts required, among other things, that all drinking water be boiled as a hygienic precaution.
sentences.zh: 他颁布的一道颇有远见的法令规定，所有饮用水都必须煮沸，以作为一种卫生上的防范措施。

sentences.en: One summer day, while visiting a distant region of his realm, he and the court stopped to rest.
sentences.zh: 一个夏日，在巡视自己疆域中一处偏远地区时，他和随行的群臣停下休息。

sentences.en: In accordance with his ruling, the servants began to boil water for the court to drink.
sentences.zh: 按照他的法令，仆从们开始为群臣烧水饮用。

sentences.en: Dried leaves from a nearby bush fell into the boiling water, and as the leaves infused the water turned brown.
sentences.zh: 附近一丛灌木的几片干叶落进了沸水中，叶子浸泡之下，水变成了褐色。

sentences.en: As a scientist, the Emperor was intrigued by the new liquid, drank some, and found it very refreshing.
sentences.zh: 作为一位科学家，神农帝对这种新的液体颇感好奇，喝了一些，发现它十分提神。

sentences.en: And so, according to legend, tea was created.
sentences.zh: 于是，相传茶就这样诞生了。

sentences.en: B Tea consumption spread throughout Chinese culture, reaching into every aspect of society.
sentences.zh: 饮茶之风传遍了中国文化，渗透到社会的方方面面。

sentences.en: The first definitive book was written on tea – a book clearly reflecting Zen Buddhist philosophy – 1,200 years ago.
sentences.zh: 第一部论茶的权威著作写于一千二百年前——这部书明显反映出禅宗的哲学思想。

sentences.en: The first tea seeds were brought to Japan by a returning Buddhist priest, who had seen the value of tea in enhancing meditation in China.
sentences.zh: 第一批茶种是由一位归国的佛教僧人带到日本的，他在中国看到了茶在增进禅修方面的价值。

sentences.en: As a result, he is known as the “Father of Tea” in Japan.
sentences.zh: 因此，他在日本被称为“茶之父”。

sentences.en: Because of this early association, tea in Japan has always been linked with Zen Buddhism.
sentences.zh: 由于这种早期的渊源，茶在日本始终与禅宗联系在一起。

sentences.en: Tea received the Japanese Emperor’s support almost instantly and spread rapidly from the royal court and monasteries to other sections of society.
sentences.zh: 茶几乎立刻获得了日本天皇的支持，并迅速从宫廷和寺院传播到社会的其他阶层。

sentences.en: C Tea was elevated to an art form in the Japanese tea ceremony, in which supreme importance is given to making tea in the most perfect, most polite, most graceful, most charming manner possible.
sentences.zh: 在日本的茶道中，茶被提升为一种艺术形式，其中至关重要的是要以尽可能完美、尽可能恭谨、尽可能优雅、尽可能动人的方式来沏茶。

sentences.en: Such a purity of expression prompted the creation of a particular form of architecture for tea houses, duplicating the simplicity of a forest cottage.
sentences.zh: 这样一种纯粹的表达方式，促成了一种专门的茶室建筑形式的诞生，它再现了林间小屋的质朴。

sentences.en: The cultural/artistic hostesses of Japan, the geishas, began to specialise in the presentation of the tea ceremony.
sentences.zh: 日本兼具文化与艺术修养的女主人——艺伎，开始专门从事茶道的演示。

sentences.en: However, as more and more people became involved in the excitement surrounding tea, the purity of the original concept was lost, and for a period the tea ceremony became corrupted, boisterous and highly embellished.
sentences.zh: 然而，随着越来越多的人卷入围绕茶的热潮，最初理念的那份纯粹渐渐丧失，有一段时期，茶道变得堕落、喧闹而又过分雕饰。

sentences.en: Efforts were then made to return to the earlier simplicity, with the result that, in the 15th and 16th centuries, tea was viewed as the ultimate gift.
sentences.zh: 于是人们努力回归早先的质朴，结果在15世纪和16世纪，茶被视为至高无上的礼物。

sentences.en: Even warlords paused for tea before battles.
sentences.zh: 就连军阀也会在战前停下来饮一杯茶。

sentences.en: D While tea was at this high level of development in parts of Asia, information concerning the then-unknown beverage began to filter back to Europe.
sentences.zh: 正当茶在亚洲部分地区发展到这一高度之时，关于这种当时尚不为人知的饮品的信息，开始陆续传回欧洲。

sentences.en: Earlier traders had mentioned it, but were unclear as to whether tea should be eaten or drunk.
sentences.zh: 早先的商人曾提到过它，却不清楚茶究竟应该吃还是该喝。

sentences.en: The first European to personally encounter tea and write about it was Portuguese – Portugal, with her technologically advanced navy, had been successful in gaining the first right of trade with China.
sentences.zh: 第一个亲身接触茶并著文记述它的欧洲人是葡萄牙人——拥有技术先进的海军的葡萄牙，已成功取得了与中国通商的最初权利。

sentences.en: E Tea finally arrived in Europe in the 16th century, brought to Holland by the country’s navy, and became very fashionable in the Dutch capital, The Hague.
sentences.zh: 茶终于在16世纪传入欧洲，由荷兰海军带到荷兰，并在荷兰首都海牙大为流行。

sentences.en: This was due in part to tea being very expensive (over $100 per pound), which immediately made it the domain of the wealthy.
sentences.zh: 这在一定程度上是因为茶非常昂贵（每磅100多美元），这使它一下子成了富人的专属之物。

sentences.en: Slowly, as the amount of tea imported increased, the price fell, and by 1675 it was available in common food shops throughout Holland.
sentences.zh: 随着进口茶叶数量的增加，茶价逐渐下跌，到1675年，荷兰各地普通的食品店里都能买到茶了。

sentences.en: F As the consumption of tea increased dramatically in Dutch society, doctors and university authorities in Holland argued as to its benefits or drawbacks.
sentences.zh: 随着茶在荷兰社会的消费量急剧上升，荷兰的医生和大学权威就茶的益处或害处展开了争论。

sentences.en: The public largely ignored the scholarly debate and continued to enjoy their new beverage, though the controversy lasted from 1635 to roughly 1657.
sentences.zh: 公众基本上无视这场学术争论，继续享用他们的新饮品，尽管这场争议从1635年一直持续到大约1657年。

sentences.en: Throughout this period, France and Holland led Europe in the use of tea.
sentences.zh: 在整个这一时期，法国和荷兰在饮茶方面引领着欧洲。

sentences.en: G As the craze for all things oriental swept through Europe, tea became part of everyday life.
sentences.zh: 随着对一切东方事物的狂热席卷欧洲，茶成了日常生活的一部分。

sentences.en: Adding milk to the drink was first mentioned in 1680.
sentences.zh: 在饮品中加奶的做法最早见于1680年的记载。

sentences.en: Around that time, Dutch inns provided the first restaurant service of tea.
sentences.zh: 大约在那时，荷兰的客栈提供了最早的茶水餐饮服务。

sentences.en: Innkeepers would furnish guests with a portable tea set complete with a heating unit.
sentences.zh: 客栈老板会为客人备上一套便携茶具，连加热装置也一应俱全。

sentences.en: The Dutchman would then prepare tea for himself and his friends outside in the inn garden.
sentences.zh: 荷兰人随后会在客栈花园里为自己和朋友沏茶。

sentences.en: Tea remained popular in France for only about fifty years, being replaced by a preference for wine, chocolate and exotic coffees.
sentences.zh: 茶在法国只流行了约五十年，便被人们对葡萄酒、巧克力和各种异域咖啡的偏爱所取代。

sentences.en: Tea was introduced into England in 1660 by King Charles II and his Portuguese queen, who were both confirmed tea drinkers.
sentences.zh: 1660年，茶由查理二世国王及其葡萄牙王后引入英格兰，两人都是不折不扣的饮茶者。

sentences.en: Tea mania swept across England as it had earlier spread throughout France and Holland.
sentences.zh: 正如茶早先传遍法国和荷兰一样，饮茶的狂热也席卷了英格兰。

sentences.en: By 1708, tea importation had risen to thirteen times the 1699 level.
sentences.zh: 到1708年，茶叶进口量已升至1699年水平的十三倍。

sentences.en: Tea was drunk by all levels of society.
sentences.zh: 社会各阶层的人都饮茶。

sentences.en: H Russian interest in tea began as early as 1618, when the Chinese embassy in Moscow presented several chests of tea to the Emperor, Czar Alexis.
sentences.zh: 俄国对茶的兴趣早在1618年就开始了，当时中国驻莫斯科的使团向沙皇阿列克谢进献了几箱茶叶。

sentences.en: Later in the century, a trade treaty between Russia and China allowed caravans to cross back and forth freely between the two countries.
sentences.zh: 到了那个世纪的后期，俄中之间的一项贸易条约允许商队在两国之间自由往返。

sentences.en: Still, the journey was not easy.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，这段旅程并不轻松。

sentences.en: The average caravan consisted of 200 to 300 camels, and the 18,000-kilometre trip took over 16 months to complete.
sentences.zh: 一支商队平均由200到300峰骆驼组成，全程18000公里的路要花16个多月才能走完。

sentences.en: Eventually, however, tea became – as it still is – one of the most popular drinks in the country.
sentences.zh: 然而，茶最终成为——并且至今仍然是——这个国家最受欢迎的饮品之一。

sentences.en: A Street soccer, as its name implies, is an informal variation of the sport, often played on the street, particularly in urban areas.
sentences.zh: 街头足球，顾名思义，是这项运动的一种非正式变体，常常在街上踢，尤其在城市地区。

sentences.en: There are many reasons for the widespread popularity of street soccer.
sentences.zh: 街头足球广受欢迎有许多原因。

sentences.en: Unlike youth soccer, its more formally organized counterpart, no large space is needed, and goal posts, corner markers, and marked lines, associated with the formal game, are typically absent, as are game officials or referees.
sentences.zh: 与它更正式组织起来的对应物青少年足球不同，它不需要大片空间，与正式比赛相关的球门柱、角旗和画好的边线通常都没有，比赛官员或裁判也没有。

sentences.en: Another attraction of street soccer is that it is played frequently and competitively, but does not necessarily require standard 11-a-side teams or fixed playing positions.
sentences.zh: 街头足球的另一个吸引力在于，它经常被踢、有竞争性，但不一定需要标准的11人对11人的球队或固定的场上位置。

sentences.en: Unlike in youth soccer, inexperienced street soccer players rarely learn from repetitive technical and tactical drills.
sentences.zh: 与青少年足球不同，没有经验的街头足球球员很少从重复的技术和战术训练中学习。

sentences.en: Instead, they learn from their poor performance in competition, unconscious of the skills they are nonetheless developing, and without older adults or coaches present.
sentences.zh: 相反，他们从自己在比赛中糟糕的表现中学习，却没意识到他们仍在发展的技能，而且没有年长的成年人或教练在场。

sentences.en: Players learn without effort through playing the game, and soon attain an almost natural feeling for the sport.
sentences.zh: 球员通过踢球毫不费力地学习，很快就对这项运动获得一种近乎天生的感觉。

sentences.en: B However, there are lots of cities in the world today where conditions are such that street soccer is no longer possible.
sentences.zh: 然而，今天世界上有很多城市，条件已使街头足球不再可能。

sentences.en: Congested traffic now dominates where games were once played.
sentences.zh: 拥堵的交通如今主导着曾经踢球的地方。

sentences.en: Parks and open fields are used as hangouts for older teenagers with other interests.
sentences.zh: 公园和开阔的场地被有别的兴趣的大龄青少年当作聚集地。

sentences.en: Add to this the requirement in many localities for official permits to use public spaces and the managed schedules that many young people have today, and spontaneous play of any kind is hard to imagine.
sentences.zh: 再加上许多地方使用公共空间需要官方许可的要求，以及今天许多年轻人被安排好的日程，任何形式的自发玩耍都难以想象。

sentences.en: C In spite of all these obstacles, which are probably solvable in most instances, there is another sociological explanation of why in many places street soccer doesn’t enjoy the same popularity it once did.
sentences.zh: 尽管有所有这些大概在多数情况下可以解决的障碍，但对于为什么在许多地方街头足球不再享有它曾经的那种人气，还有另一种社会学解释。

sentences.en: In his book How Soccer Explains the World, US writer Franklin Foer observes: But for all the talk of freedom, the 1960s parenting style had a far less relaxed side too.
sentences.zh: 美国作家Franklin Foer在他的书《How Soccer Explains the World》中观察到，但尽管把自由挂在嘴边，20世纪60年代的育儿方式也有远不那么宽松的一面。

sentences.en: Like the 1960s consumer movement which brought seat belts and airbags to cars, the (youth) soccer movement felt like it could create a set of ...
sentences.zh: 就像给汽车带来安全带和安全气囊的20世纪60年代消费者运动一样，（青少年）足球运动感觉它能创造一套……

sentences.en: regulations that would protect both the child’s body and mind from damage.
sentences.zh: 能保护孩子身心免受伤害的规章。

sentences.en: Soccer leagues like the one I played in as a child handed out ‘participation’ prizes to every player, no matter how few games his (or her) team won.
sentences.zh: 像我小时候参加的那种足球联赛，给每个球员都发“参与”奖，无论他（或她）的球队赢的比赛多么少。

sentences.en: Where most of the world accepts the practice of using your head to hit the ball as an essential element of the game, some (youth) soccer parents have worried over the potential for injury to the brain.
sentences.zh: 在世界大多数地方都接受用头顶球作为比赛一个基本要素这种做法的地方，一些（青少年）足球家长却为对大脑潜在的伤害而担忧。

sentences.en: An entire industry grew up to manufacture protective headgear.
sentences.zh: 一个完整的产业兴起，来制造护头装备。

sentences.en: Even though very little medical evidence supports this fear, some youth leagues prohibited heading the ball altogether.
sentences.zh: 尽管几乎没有医学证据支持这种担忧，一些青少年联赛仍完全禁止头球。

sentences.en: D A growing body of people don’t believe street soccer involves a legitimate educational method.
sentences.zh: 越来越多的人不相信街头足球涉及一种正当的教育方法。

sentences.en: They argue that children need to be taught by experts.
sentences.zh: 他们争辩说，孩子需要由专家来教。

sentences.en: Youth soccer instruction now begins with four-year-olds, so that they will have an advantage as six- year-olds.
sentences.zh: 青少年足球教学如今从四岁的孩子开始，好让他们作为六岁的孩子能有优势。

sentences.en: This need to get ahead brings with it a fear of falling behind that only expert instruction can prevent.
sentences.zh: 这种抢先的需要带来一种落后的恐惧，而只有专家的指导才能防止落后。

sentences.en: This type of instruction leaves no room for the trial-and-error approach of street soccer.
sentences.zh: 这种教学给街头足球那种试错的方法不留余地。

sentences.en: E One of the basic ideas of street soccer is that young players are assigned a particular role by a better player and are expected to play for the good of the team.
sentences.zh: 街头足球的一个基本理念是，年轻球员被一位更好的球员指派一个特定的角色，并被期望为球队的利益而踢球。

sentences.en: Such an assignment runs counter to the idea of youth soccer that every child needs to learn every position and will benefit from doing so.
sentences.zh: 这样的指派与青少年足球的理念相悖，后者认为每个孩子都需要学会每个位置、并会从中受益。

sentences.en: In street soccer, you fill the role that you are best able to at a particular time.
sentences.zh: 在街头足球里，你在某个特定时刻担任你最有能力胜任的角色。

sentences.en: While this role assignment can change from game to game, the purpose is always the same: to get the best out of each individual at any given moment.
sentences.zh: 虽然这种角色指派可以一场比赛一变，但目的始终相同，在任何给定时刻把每个人最好的一面发挥出来。

sentences.en: F In street soccer, children have to learn patience, to wait their turn, to realize that they are not entitled to make decisions, or even be listened to simply because they show up.
sentences.zh: 在街头足球里，孩子们必须学会耐心、等待轮到自己，认识到他们没有资格仅仅因为露了面就做决定、甚至被听取意见。

sentences.en: Positions of responsibility are earned through competition within the team.
sentences.zh: 负责的位置是通过球队内部的竞争赢得的。

sentences.en: Younger players in street soccer must wait to attain those positions.
sentences.zh: 街头足球里较年轻的球员必须等待才能获得那些位置。

sentences.en: In youth soccer, however, with its overly democratic values, youngsters are guaranteed their time in the spotlight.
sentences.zh: 然而在青少年足球里，凭着它过度民主的价值观，年轻人被保证有他们出风头的时刻。

sentences.en: Whether it’s their turn to be captain, to play a central position or to take a crucial shot, youth soccer players come to believe that hard work and patience aren’t really necessary.
sentences.zh: 无论是轮到他们当队长、踢中心位置还是踢关键的一脚，青少年足球球员渐渐相信努力和耐心其实并不必要。

sentences.en: G Not only does every youth soccer player get a chance, it is assumed that each individual has played well.
sentences.zh: 不仅每个青少年足球球员都有机会，而且每个人都被假定踢得很好。

sentences.en: ‘Everyone’s a winner; no one’s a loser’ is a guiding principle of youth soccer.
sentences.zh: “人人都是赢家；没有人是输家”是青少年足球的一条指导原则。

sentences.en: This ensures each individual goes away positive about themselves.
sentences.zh: 这确保每个人离开时对自己感觉良好。

sentences.en: No one can leave a game or a practice feeling bad.
sentences.zh: 没有人能带着糟糕的感觉离开一场比赛或一次训练。

sentences.en: But, if there really are no losers, then why try at all?
sentences.zh: 但是，如果真的没有输家，那为什么还要努力？

sentences.en: Since giving less than your best receives the same reward as giving your best, why go to any extra effort?
sentences.zh: 既然付出不及全力得到的奖励和付出全力一样，为什么还要额外费力？

sentences.en: In street soccer, every game results in a winner and a loser and everyone knows who is who.
sentences.zh: 在街头足球里，每场比赛都分出一个赢家和一个输家，每个人都知道谁是谁。

sentences.en: Losing a game is a common experience and players learn early on how to handle this.
sentences.zh: 输掉一场比赛是常有的经历，球员很早就学会如何应对这一点。

sentences.en: As a result, unlike most youth soccer players, they acquire resilience.
sentences.zh: 结果，与大多数青少年足球球员不同，他们获得了复原力。

sentences.en: A further difference between these two strands of soccer is that in street soccer a formal record is not kept.
sentences.zh: 这两类足球的另一个区别是，在街头足球里不保留正式记录。

sentences.en: You can lose one day and win the next.
sentences.zh: 你可以今天输、明天赢。

sentences.en: The results are only temporary and are forgotten within minutes of the end of the match.
sentences.zh: 结果只是暂时的，比赛结束后几分钟内就被遗忘。

sentences.en: But in organized youth soccer, the position each person plays and the results are formally noted and maintained throughout a season.
sentences.zh: 但在有组织的青少年足球里，每个人踢的位置和结果都被正式记录，并在整个赛季中保留。

questions.stemEn: a contrast between the ways young players gain experience of playing different positions
questions.anaZh: E 段对比了两种足球的“分工方式”：街头足球是按能力分配角色（best able to），而青少年足球要求每个孩子学习所有位置（learn every position）。
questions.anaEn: (Paragraph E) One of the basic ideas of street soccer is that young players are assigned a particular role... Such an assignment runs counter to the idea of youth soccer that every child needs to learn every position...

questions.stemEn: examples out side of sport greater emphasis on individual safety
questions.anaZh: C 段提到了汽车的安全带和安全气囊（seat belts and airbags），这是体育运动之外（out side sport）重视个体安全的典型例子。
questions.anaEn: (Paragraph C) Like the 1960s consumer movement which brought seat belts and airbags to cars, the (youth) soccer movement felt like it could create a set of ... regulations...

questions.stemEn: a description of methods of selection for leadership on soccer teams
questions.anaZh: F 段描述了街头足球中，队长等负责任的职位（Positions of responsibility）是通过竞争赢得的，而青少年足球则是轮流坐庄。
questions.anaEn: (Paragraph F) Positions of responsibility are earned through competition within the team. Younger players in street soccer must wait to attain those positions.

questions.stemEn: details of urban changes that discourage street soccer
questions.anaZh: B 段列举了交通拥堵（Congested traffic）、场地被占用、需要官方许可（official permits）等城市变化，这些都阻碍了街头足球的开展。
questions.anaEn: (Paragraph B) Congested traffic now dominates where games were once played... Add to this the requirement in many localities for official permits...

questions.stemEn: a mention of the lesson that failure teaches street soccer players
questions.anaZh: G 段明确指出，在街头足球中输球是常事，这教会了球员如何应对失败，从而获得了“韧性（resilience）”。
questions.anaEn: (Paragraph G) Losing a game is a common experience and players learn early on how to handle this. As a result... they acquire resilience.

questions.stemEn: an explanation of why youth soccer emphasises the need for coaches
questions.anaZh: D 段解释了为什么要请教练：因为家长和体系害怕孩子“落后（falling behind）”，认为只有专家指导（expert instruction）才能避免这点。
questions.anaEn: (Paragraph D) This need to get ahead brings with it a fear of falling behind that only expert instruction can prevent.

records.title: A closer examination of a study on verbal and non-verbal messages

sentences.en: (A) The findings of a study on verbal and non-verbal messages in communication by Albert Mehrabian and his colleagues at UCLA in 1967 have been quoted so frequently that they are now often regarded as a self-evident truth.
sentences.zh: 1967 年阿尔伯特·梅赫拉比安（Albert Mehrabian）及其在加州大学洛杉矶分校（UCLA）的同事所做的一项关于言语与非言语信息的沟通研究的发现，被引用得如此频繁，以至于现在常被视为不证自明的真理。

sentences.en: (B) In the first experiment, subjects were asked to listen to a recording of a female saying the word “maybe” in three tones of voice to convey liking, neutrality, and disliking.
sentences.zh: 在第一项实验中，受试者被要求听一段录音：一名女性用三种不同语气说“maybe”这个词，分别表达喜欢、中性和不喜欢。

sentences.en: The subjects were then shown photos of female faces expressing the same three emotions and were asked to guess the emotions in the recorded voice and the photos.
sentences.zh: 随后他们看到一些表现同样三种情绪的女性面部照片，被要求猜测录音中和照片里的情绪。

sentences.en: It was found that the photos received more accurate responses than the voices.
sentences.zh: 结果发现，照片得到的回答比语音更准确。

sentences.en: In the second experiment, subjects listened to nine recorded words spoken in different tones of voice.
sentences.zh: 在第二项实验中，受试者听 9 个以不同语气录下的词。

sentences.en: Three words had positive meanings (e.g.
sentences.zh: 3 个有正面含义（例如

sentences.en: honey), three were neutral (e.g.
sentences.zh: honey），3 个中性（例如

sentences.en: oh), and three were negative (e.g.
sentences.zh: oh），3 个负面（例如

sentences.en: terrible).
sentences.zh: terrible）。

sentences.en: Again, the subjects had to guess the speaker’s emotions.
sentences.zh: 受试者再次需要猜出说话者的情绪。

sentences.en: It was found that tone of voice carried more meaning than the individual words.
sentences.zh: 结果发现，语气所传达的含义比词语本身更多。

sentences.en: From these experiments the researchers concluded that 7% of our feeling towards a speaker is based on the actual words they use, 38% on their tone of voice, and 55% on their body language (e.g.
sentences.zh: 研究者由这些实验得出结论：我们对说话者的感受 7% 取决于他们实际使用的词，38% 取决于其语气，55% 取决于其肢体语言（例如

sentences.en: facial expression).
sentences.zh: 面部表情）。

sentences.en: Methodological Issues
sentences.zh: 方法论上的问题

sentences.en: (C) However, a closer look at the study reveals several limitations.
sentences.zh: 然而，对该研究的近距离审视暴露出若干局限。

sentences.en: The first is that the entire study involved only 62 subjects.
sentences.zh: 第一是整项研究只涉及 62 名受试者。

sentences.en: Of these, 25 were used to select the word for the first experiment, while the key issue – comparing verbal and non-verbal communication – was determined by only the 37 remaining subjects.
sentences.zh: 其中 25 人被用来为第一项实验挑选词语，而真正的关键问题——比较言语与非言语沟通——则只由其余 37 名受试者决定。

sentences.en: All were female undergraduates who participated as part of their introductory psychology course, and their ages and academic qualifications seem remarkably uniform.
sentences.zh: 她们全是作为心理学入门课程一部分而参加的女性本科生，年龄和学历都相当一致。

sentences.en: Thus, the findings may simply be a product of the nature of the sample.
sentences.zh: 因此，研究结果可能只是这种样本性质的产物。

sentences.en: (D) Critics have also pointed out that the 7–38–55 formula is flawed since it was pieced together from two different experiments, neither of which involved all three channels (verbal, vocal, and facial).
sentences.zh: 批评者还指出，7—38—55 这一公式是有缺陷的，因为它是把两项不同实验拼凑起来的——而这两项实验都没有同时涉及全部三个通道（言语、声音和面部）。

sentences.en: In addition, in the first experiment the single word “maybe” was used throughout so it was impossible for the effects of changes in verbal input to be assessed.
sentences.zh: 此外，在第一项实验中始终只用“maybe”这一个词，因此根本无法评估言语输入变化的影响。

sentences.en: The researchers intentionally used a “neutral” word so naturally the subjects found little meaning there.
sentences.zh: 研究者有意使用一个“中性”的词，于是受试者从中自然找不到什么含义。

sentences.en: Clearly, such a methodology lacks validity.
sentences.zh: 显然，这样的方法论缺乏效度。

sentences.en: In the real world, people communicate in a particular context and speak in phrases and full-blown sentences, making extensive use of the multi-faceted vehicle of language.
sentences.zh: 在现实世界中，人们在特定语境中交流，使用短语和完整句子，广泛使用多维度的语言载体。

sentences.en: (E) My concern is that interpretations of this study have gained such prominence in our pedagogical literature.
sentences.zh: 我担心的是，这项研究的诠释在我们的教学文献中获得了如此显著的位置。

sentences.en: This 7–38–55 formula appears in many basic texts, used for training in public speaking, interpersonal communication, and organizational communication.
sentences.zh: 7—38—55 这一公式出现在许多基础教材里，被用于公开演讲、人际沟通和组织沟通的培训之中。

sentences.en: Lessons to consider
sentences.zh: 值得思考的教训

sentences.en: (F) Clearly, one appealing aspect of the Mehrabian study is its numerical precision.
sentences.zh: 显然，梅赫拉比安研究的一个吸引人之处在于其数字的精确性。

sentences.en: Communication is a complex phenomenon, but it seems less so when we can rely on these three magical numbers.
sentences.zh: 沟通是一种复杂现象，但当我们能依赖这三个神奇数字时，它看上去就不那么复杂了。

sentences.en: In contrast to the ambiguities of language, numbers seem to possess exactness.
sentences.zh: 与语言的含混相比，数字似乎拥有精确性。

sentences.en: And the popular appeal of the study has given the 7–38–55 formula enormous credibility.
sentences.zh: 研究的大众吸引力也让 7—38—55 这一公式获得了巨大的可信度。

sentences.en: There is a certain mystique about non-verbal communication, and the continued references to this research sustain it, encouraging people to believe in the overwhelming importance of the non-verbal message compared with the verbal one.
sentences.zh: 非言语沟通有一种神秘感，而对这项研究的持续援引在维持这种神秘感——它让人们相信非言语信息相对于言语信息具有压倒性的重要性。

sentences.en: Yet we know that even one ill-chosen word to a colleague or friend can make or break a communicative effort.
sentences.zh: 然而我们知道，对同事或朋友哪怕一个用得不好的词，都可能成就或破坏一次沟通努力。

sentences.en: Words do matter.
sentences.zh: 词语确实重要。

sentences.en: Bradley (1991), one of the few textbook writers to criticize the Mehrabian study, makes the same point when he observes, “If we could communicate 93% of information and attitudes with vocal and facial cues, it would be wasteful to spend time learning a language.”
sentences.zh: 布拉德利（Bradley，1991 年）是少数几位批评梅赫拉比安研究的教材作者之一，他也指出：“如果我们 93% 的信息和态度都能通过声音和面部线索传递，那花时间学习语言就是浪费。”

sentences.en: (G) Mehrabian himself believes his research should not be interpreted to devalue the role of language in communication, saying: “Please remember that all my findings…
sentences.zh: 梅赫拉比安本人也认为，他的研究不应被解读为贬低语言在沟通中的作用，他说：“请记住，我所有的发现……

sentences.en: dealt with communications of feelings and attitudes…
sentences.zh: 涉及的都是感受和态度的沟通……

sentences.en: it is absurd to imply or suggest that the verbal portion of all communication constitutes only 7% of the message…
sentences.zh: 暗示或建议所有沟通的言语部分只占信息的 7%，是荒谬的……

sentences.en: anytime we communicate abstract relationships (e.g., x = y – the square of z) clearly 100% of the entire communication is verbal.”
sentences.zh: 任何时候我们传达抽象关系（例如 x = y − z 的平方），整次沟通显然 100% 都是言语的。“

sentences.en: (Mehrabian, 1995)
sentences.zh: （梅赫拉比安，1995 年）

sentences.en: (H) To be fair, many textbook writers attempt to be faithful to the context of Mehrabian’s research.
sentences.zh: 公平地说，许多教材作者都试图忠实地呈现梅赫拉比安研究的语境。

sentences.en: For example, Stewart and D’Angelo (1988) write: “Mehrabian argues that when we’re uncertain about what someone’s feeling, or about how much we like him or her, we rely…
sentences.zh: 例如，斯图尔特和达安杰洛（Stewart and D’Angelo，1988 年）写道：“梅赫拉比安认为，当我们不确定别人在感受什么、或我们多喜欢对方时，我们依赖……

sentences.en: only 7% on the words that are spoken.”
sentences.zh: 只有 7% 取决于所说的词。“

sentences.en: Others try to play down the specific percentages, saying that an understanding of the general importance of non-verbal cues is more important.
sentences.zh: 另一些人则试图淡化具体百分比，认为对非言语线索整体重要性的理解更为重要。

sentences.en: Nonetheless, other textbook authors simply use the numbers without placing any limits on their meaning.
sentences.zh: 然而，仍有教材作者直接使用这些数字，而没有对其含义加以任何限制。

sentences.en: Conclusion
sentences.zh: 结论

sentences.en: (I) Since this relatively small study was first published it has achieved an influence far beyond its intended scope.
sentences.zh: 自这项相对较小的研究首次发表以来，其影响力已远远超出最初的预期范围。

sentences.en: We need to put it into its proper perspective and learn some important lessons from it regarding social science research, communication pedagogy, and the forces which have created widespread misunderstanding about communication.
sentences.zh: 我们需要把它置于恰当的视角，并从中吸取一些重要教训——关于社会科学研究、沟通教学以及那些造成对沟通广泛误解的力量。

questions.anaEn: Description of the Study: The findings of a study on verbal and non-verbal messages in communication by Albert Mehrabian and his colleagues at UCLA in 1967 have been quoted so frequently that they are now often regarded as a self-evident truth.

questions.anaEn: Description of the Study: The subjects were then shown photos of female faces expressing the same three emotions and were asked to guess the emotions in the recorded voice and the photos.

questions.anaZh: 第二个实验中使用了三类词：积极含义、中性含义和消极含义，研究发现语调比“individual words”（单词本身）更重要，这里比较的就是语调与“词义”。

questions.stemEn: One limitation of the study was that there were too few subjects involved.
questions.anaZh: 作者在指出的第一个局限性中，明确批评整个研究只涉及了62名受试者，这直接对应题目说的“受试者太少”。
questions.anaEn: Methodological Issues: The first is that the entire study involved only 62 subjects.

questions.stemEn: The fact that the subjects in the study came from a similar background was an advantage.
questions.anaZh: 作者指出受试者全是心理学入门课程的女大学生，背景高度一致，导致结果可能只是该特定样本的产物，这意味着背景相似是“劣势”而非题目说的“优势”。
questions.anaEn: Methodological Issues: All were female undergraduates... and their ages and academic qualifications seem remarkably uniform. Thus, the findings may simply be a product of the nature of the sample.

questions.stemEn: The two experiments should have been carried out in a different order.
questions.anaZh: 文中分别描述了两个实验的内容和缺陷，但从未提及它们的“顺序”是否错误，或者是否应该调换顺序。
questions.anaEn: Description of the Study: In the first experiment... In the second experiment...  (文中仅按顺序叙述，无对顺序优劣的评价)。

questions.stemEn: The researchers’ choice of a neutral word was helpful in the context of the study.
questions.anaZh: 作者认为研究人员故意使用“中性词”导致受试者自然无法从中找到意义，只能依赖语调，这种方法论是“缺乏有效性”（lacks validity）的，即这种选择是不合理的。
questions.anaEn: Methodological Issues: The researchers intentionally used a "neutral" word so naturally the subjects found little meaning there. Clearly, such a methodology lacks validity.

questions.stemEn: The study would have been more valid if it had included a range of languages.
questions.anaZh: 作者提到现实世界中人们使用“短语和完整句子”以及“多层面的语言工具”，但并没有具体讨论如果包含“多种不同的语言”（如法语、中文等）是否会提高有效性。
questions.anaEn: Methodological Issues: In the real world, people communicate in a particular context and speak in phrases and full-blown sentences, making extensive use of the multi-faceted vehicle of language.  (只提到了语言的形式，未提多语种)。

questions.stemEn: What does the writer say about the “numerical precision” of Mehrabian’s study?

options.en: It makes the claims more attractive.
It is the strongest point of the study.
It will appeal to superstitious people.

questions.anaZh: 作者提到该研究的一个吸引人之处在于其“数字的精确性”（numerical precision），因为相比语言的模糊性，数字似乎拥有“确切性”，这让结论看起来更具吸引力。
questions.anaEn: Lessons to consider: Clearly, one appealing aspect of the Mehrabian study is its numerical precision... In contrast to the ambiguities of language, numbers seem to possess exactness.

questions.stemEn: What does the writer say about the popularity of the 7–38–55 formula?

options.en: It is unlikely to maintain its present status.
It is leading to an undervaluing of words.
It should be applied in a more practical way.
It may help understanding of non-verbal messages.

questions.anaZh: 文中指出，对这个公式的持续引用鼓励人们相信非语言信息具有压倒性的重要性，从而忽视了“文字确实很重要”（Words do matter）这一事实，导致了对语言价值的低估。
questions.anaEn: Lessons to consider: ...encouraging people to believe in the overwhelming importance of the non-verbal message compared with the verbal one... Yet we know that even one ill-chosen word... can make or break a communicative effort.

questions.stemEn: What point is Bradley making about language learning?

options.en: Language could be learned more efficiently than it is.
More research is needed into attitudes to communication.
More time should be spent looking at tone and body language.
Language must be important since we make an effort to acquire it.

questions.anaZh: Bradley 的逻辑是反证法：如果我们真的可以用非语言手段传达93%的信息，那花时间学语言就是浪费；既然我们花力气学语言，说明语言（Words）必然很重要。
questions.anaEn: Lessons to consider: Bradley (1991)... observes, "If we could communicate 93% of information and attitudes with vocal and facial cues, it would be wasteful to spend time learning a language."

questions.stemEn: What does Mehrabian himself say about his findings?

options.en: They are relevant to only one area of communication.
It is only in maths that 100% of communication is verbal.
Feelings are more difficult to communicate than numerical facts.
Non-verbal communication is the main part of the message.

questions.anaZh: Mehrabian 自己澄清说，他的发现只适用于“情感和态度”（feelings and attitudes）的沟通，而在交流抽象关系时，语言的作用是100%的，即结论只适用于特定领域。
questions.anaEn: Lessons to consider: "Please remember that all my findings... dealt with communications of feelings and attitudes... anytime we communicate abstract relationships... clearly 100% of the entire communication is verbal."

questions.stemEn: What is the writer’s purpose in the paragraph beginning “To be fair…”?

options.en: To justify the strong points of Mehrabian’s study.
To outline other research on non-verbal behaviour.
To present varying interpretations of Mehrabian’s study.
To show that textbooks tend to ignore non-verbal behaviour.

questions.anaZh: 这一段以 "To be fair" 开头，列举了三种教材作者：有的忠实于原意，有的试图淡化百分比，有的则不加限制地滥用数字，这展示了对该研究的不同解读方式。
questions.anaEn: Lessons to consider: To be fair, many textbook writers attempt to be faithful... Others try to play down... Nonetheless, other textbook authors simply use the numbers without placing any limits on their meaning.
